title: Qayerda bo'lganingizni aytish
can_do: O'tgan vaqtdagi holat va joy haqida gapira olasiz
why: Bu o'tgan zamonga birinchi qadam. Was va were — o'tgan zamonda eng ko'p ishlatiladigan ikki so'z, ular hikoyaning asosini tutadi.

rule.title: was va were — to be o'tgan zamonda

points.text: To be fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli ikkita: was va were. I, he, she, it bilan was; you, we, they bilan were.
Diqqat: hozirgi zamonda you are, o'tgan zamonda ham you were — yakka odamga murojaat qilinsa ham. «You was» — xato.
Inkor: wasn't, weren't. Savol: was yoki were gap boshiga chiqadi, xuddi hozirgi zamondagidek.

examples.en: I wasn't at work on Monday.
examples.uz: Dushanba kuni men ishda emas edim.

points.text: O'tgan zamonni ko'rsatuvchi so'zlar bilan birga ishlatiladi: yesterday, last week, last year, two days ago, in 2020.

examples.en: She was in Samarkand last week.
It was very cold two days ago.
examples.uz: Ikki kun oldin juda sovuq edi.

common_errors.why: You bilan doim were, hatto bir kishiga murojaat qilinsa ham.
To be inkorida did ishlatilmaydi — not to'g'ridan-to'g'ri was ga qo'shiladi.

common_errors.wrong: Did you were at the party?
common_errors.why: To be savolida did kerak emas — were o'zi oldinga chiqadi.

practice_spec.note: Mashqlarni AI shu spetsifikatsiya bo'yicha yaratadi. Tur raqamlari — docs/mashqlar.md dagi shkala.

items.focus: hozirgi zamon gapini o'tgan zamonga o'tkazish
«You was», «I didn't was», «Did you were» xatolarini topish
bolaligingiz haqida was / were bilan gap tuzish
o'zbekchadan tarjima: «Kecha men uyda edim», «Ular maktabda emas edi»

final.task: Bolaligingizni eslang. Qayerda yashagansiz, qanday bola edingiz, do'stlaringiz kim edi. 5 gap.

skill_task.task: Odam bolaligi haqida gapiradi. Qayerda va qanday bo'lganini yozing.
